selection.reason: Baseline uses shutil.copyfile, not copy2. V1 preserves existing byte-copy semantics; V2 metadata copying would change behavior. Earlier assumption that metadata was already preserved was false, with actual failed control retained. V2 remains a separate frozen experiment, not the final production implementation.

benchmark.scope: Warm local filesystem paired whole snapshot plus extra independent validate. Baseline shutil may use kernel fast-copy. Logical byte-pass reduction is not a physical-I/O measurement or general speedup guarantee.

native_live_suite_scope.scope: Experimental live-repository native test process overlapped the restoration to selected V1. Its actual exit/log are retained, but it is not used as proof of a wholly frozen V2 native suite. V2 extracted-source tests and all sustained V2 workers use independent frozen sources. Final production V1 full suites completed before the experiment.

unselected_metadata_experiment.scope: V2 alone adds metadata copying. Baseline used copyfile, so final V1 preserves existing semantics. V2 source, worker and report evidence remain separate; V2 does not represent the final code.

snapshot_initial.reason: Harness measured FD baseline before opening its own ledger. Corrected harness measured after opening; initial failure retained.

metadata_initial.reason: Control incorrectly assumed baseline used copy2. Actual baseline code uses copyfile and real output did not preserve mode/mtime. Assumption corrected; production restored to byte-copy-compatible V1.

ownership_audit.scope: Read-only PID/start-tick and owned cwd/argument-prefix audit. Current audit ancestors excluded. No signals or environment collection.

evidence_archive.scope: Final V1 and separate unselected metadata V2 experiment, baseline source, real tests, negative controls, six closed profiles, tool exits and full trace gzip streams. No models, arrays, cores, SDKs, Git metadata or distribution binaries. Final report/index and integrity excluded to avoid circular hashes.

limits: Opened-file identity checks are not locks; callers keep sources immutable. Concurrent ancestor replacement and network filesystem deadlines are not guaranteed.
